import json, subprocess, time
def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    if p.returncode: print('EXIT', p.stderr.decode()[:400])
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
def ch(data):
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
            "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":data}]}]}

t=time.time()
out = run(ch("{{ 'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n' * 20000 }}"))
